mapper.insert: insert into sai_model_config (provider_id, model_name, model_key, model_type, adapter_key, description, api_endpoint, scope, is_default, is_enabled, api_key, created_dt, updated_dt) values (#{providerId}, #{modelName}, #{modelKey}, #{modelType}, #{adapterKey}, #{description}, #{apiEndpoint}, #{scope}, #{isDefault}, #{isEnabled}, #{apiKey,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, now(), now())
mapper.update: update sai_model_config set api_key = #{apiKey,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, updated_dt = now() where id = #{modelId}
mapper.select: select count(1) from sai_model_config where model_key = #{modelKey}
select count(1) from sai_model_provider where id = #{providerId}
select id as provider_id, provider_name as provider_name, provider_key as provider_key from sai_model_provider where is_enabled = 1 order by id asc

select p.id as provider_id, p.provider_name as provider_name, p.provider_key as provider_key, p.description as description, p.icon_url as icon_url, p.is_enabled as is_enabled, p.created_dt as created_dt, (select count(1) from sai_model_config c where c.provider_id = p.id) as model_count from sai_model_provider p order by p.is_enabled desc, p.id asc
mapper.insert: insert into sai_model_provider (provider_name, provider_key, description, icon_url, is_enabled, created_dt, updated_dt) values (#{providerName}, #{providerKey}, #{description}, #{iconUrl}, #{isEnabled}, now(), now())
mapper.select: select c.id as model_id, c.model_key as model_key, c.model_name as model_name, c.model_type as model_type, c.adapter_key as adapter_key, c.api_endpoint as api_endpoint, c.api_key as api_key, c.is_enabled as is_enabled, p.provider_name as provider_name, p.provider_key as provider_key, g.deployment_type as deployment_type from sai_model_config c left join sai_model_provider p on p.id = c.provider_id left join aig_model_governance g on g.model_id = c.id and g.del_flag = '0' where c.id = #{modelId} limit 1
